user.title: Solar Energy Insights
user.description: Pick the battery, the house's energy counter and Solcast. With EF-PowerOcean-TcpModbus and Solcast installed they are filled in.

data_description.battery_capacity: In Wh or kWh. While it reports none, the last value is used.
data_description.battery_reserve: The reserve in force, in %. For EF-PowerOcean-TcpModbus: Effective Battery Reserve.
data_description.house_energy: A counter of energy the house used, daily or lifetime. Its recorded hours are what the night is replayed from.
data_description.grid_power: Optional: shows when a full battery is exporting (free power).
data_description.solcast_today: The Solcast sensor for today, with its detailedForecast attribute.
data_description.charge_limit: The level charging stops at, if set below 100 %. For EF-PowerOcean-TcpModbus: Charge Limit SOC. While it has no value, the option is used.

init.title: Settings
init.description: Prices, how the night is tested, and the battery's limits. Prices only turn kWh into money; they never change the plan.

data.import_positive: Grid power is positive when importing

data_description.nights: How many recent nights the battery is tested against.
data_description.min_reserve: The lowest the inverter discharges to by itself, under any reserve.
data_description.max_power: The most the battery charges or discharges at.
data_description.round_trip: Share of stored energy that comes back out.
data_description.import_positive: Turn off if import shows as negative.
data_description.price: What a kWh bought costs, in cents.
data_description.feed_in: What a kWh exported earns, in cents.
data_description.price_entity: For a dynamic tariff: overrides the electricity price while it has a value. Its current value applies to every hour ahead; nothing is timed to cheap hours. Read as cents if its unit starts with ct, else as your currency per kWh.
data_description.outdoor_temperature: A thermometer with statistics. Nights that followed similar weather may then count more, but only if that predicts recent evenings better.
data_description.presence: A sensor with statistics that counts who is home, such as a template counting people at home. Used the same way.
data_description.solar_energy: A counter of what the panels made. With it, Solcast's morning forecasts are compared with what came, and a correction for this roof is used once it beats the raw forecast.
data_description.max_charge: The level the battery charges to when no entity gives it: lower it if the app stops charging below 100 %. Full means reaching it.
data_description.achievements: Score, levels, streaks, records, badges and quests, earned from your history. The first start replays the history the recorder holds.
data_description.grid_import_energy: A counter of energy bought. With the export counter, unlocks self-sufficiency, grid-free days and the badges that use them.
data_description.grid_export_energy: A counter of energy sold. Unlocks solar kept at home and export badges.
data_description.battery_cycles: Each battery pack's own count of full cycles, averaged; from the EcoFlow cloud integration when installed. Without it, "Cycle master" is not offered.
data_description.battery_health: Each pack's state of health, %. The plan uses the nominal capacity times their average.
data_description.charge_power_limit: The battery's live charge limit, as its management system sets it (lower when cold). Replaces the fixed power limit for charging while it reports.
data_description.discharge_power_limit: The battery's live discharge limit, the same way for discharging.
data_description.array_kwp: The panels' DC size. Read from Solcast's rooftop sites, with where each one faces; set it here only if Solcast's sites do not give it.
